title: Camps C1 · 3 of 3 — the Compare dialog and Print roster while “Hide private details” is on
subtitle: Two more places that show money with the switch on today. Compare dialog (“… is signed up twice”): Paying by, Total and Payment keep their rows, read gray “Hidden on this tablet” and are never marked different (Dashboard core plan §10; the shared Compare dialog’s hidden rows, v1.102). Print roster: paper isn’t a screen, but the printout can lie on the mat — a question for Jeffrey, one option drawn. Amber = what changes.

items.caption: Compare dialog, PC 1280×800. Paying by, “$390 / $315” and “Paid Mar 10 / Not paid” show, highlighted as differences.

row.caption: Print roster (as the printer sees it). The Paid column prints whatever the switch says.

items.caption: Compare dialog, PC. The three money rows read “Hidden on this tablet”, never highlighted. Signed up, Reference, Days and Extras stay, so staff can still tell the two apart and Keep one.

row.caption: Print roster — option drawn: with the switch on, the sheet has no Paid column; “Possible duplicate” moves next to the name. With the switch off it prints as today.

footer: Question for Jeffrey (Print roster): follow the switch (drawn — the sheet then matches the screen it was printed from), or always print the Paid column (it is the staff’s own sheet, design review CP5)? Recommendation: follow the switch, as every screen does (v0.249: “every screen, in every section”). Scripts: mock-c01-compare-hidden.js, mock-c01-print-hidden.js.
